The '''Heritage Squad''' was a branch of the [[Human League]] based on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Squad was charged with creating propaganda proving that the [[Human/Legends|Human]] species should be the rulers of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].
